## Detailed Findings

#### 1. Defer Hub replacement until sessions end + defer auto-update install (infra, ~6h, SKIP)

- **What**: Cline #13231 "fix(core): defer replacing a Hub that is serving live sessions" + #13233 "fix(cli): defer auto-update install until no CLI is attached to the hub" (merged 2026-08-14). Hub lifecycle hardening to prevent mid-session daemon swaps. #13231: Retiring a Hub kills its WebSockets (code=1006 abnormal close mid-turn). Defer replacement while the Hub reports live sessions (attach to older Hub over compatible wire protocol, swap once sessions end). Add `outdated_hub` mismatch direction (informational dialog, "Update finishes next time Cline starts", no install needed). Busy now means: participants attached (live socket subscriptions) OR turn executing (running/pending status), NOT stale non-terminal status (crashed client leaves session "running" forever, was pinning outdated Hub indefinitely, confirmed via QA). #13233: Installing while cline processes run swaps npm package under them (respawn paths break on new build fingerprint, updater restarted hub daemon under live sessions causing 1006 incident). Startup check now records update available but does NOT install. Install runs at process exit, only when hub confirms no cli* client attached (desktop sidecars/connectors ship own binaries, only cli* clients make swap unsafe). Deletes restartHubServerIfRunning, ensureCliHubServerAfterUpdate. Manual 'cline update' installs immediately, notes update applies on next start. Exit-time update gate bounded to 3s (wedged hub cannot stall CLI for tens of seconds), grant in-flight version check 250ms grace (sub-second commands exited before startup check resolved, silently dropped update every time), cross-check sessions with participants (client.list can lose TUI registration during transport churn while session connection survives, empty client list not proof of safety, participant-less scheduled runs live in hub process which binary swap does not touch).
- **Why**: Alexi has no shared Hub daemon (single-process CLI, no multi-installation coordination, no background auto-update). Skip (Cline-specific Hub lifecycle architecture, no cross-cutting pattern for Alexi's single-process model, no shared daemon to replace/defer, no background updater, zero portable insights).
- **Source**: Cline PR #13231 "fix(core): defer replacing a Hub that is serving live sessions" (merged 2026-08-14). Full PR at https://github.com/cline/cline/pull/13231. Root cause: retiring Hub kills WebSockets mid-turn (code=1006). Fix: defer replacement while Hub has participants or executing turns, attach to older Hub over compatible wire, swap when sessions end. Add `outdated_hub` mismatch direction (info toast, no modal). Busy = participants OR running/pending status. Cline PR #13233 "fix(cli): defer auto-update install until no CLI is attached to the hub" (merged 2026-08-14). Full PR at https://github.com/cline/cline/pull/13233. Root cause: installing while processes run swaps npm package, breaks respawn paths, restarts hub under live sessions. Fix: startup records update available, install at process exit only when hub confirms no cli* clients attached. 3s timeout gate, 250ms grace for startup check, cross-check sessions with participants.
- **Category**: infra (Hub lifecycle). **Size**: ~6h. **Priority**: SKIP (Cline-specific Hub daemon architecture, no shared daemon in Alexi, zero portability).

#### 2. Stop concurrent Hub installs from retiring each other (infra, ~4h, SKIP)

- **What**: Cline #13230 "fix(core): stop concurrent Hub installs from retiring each other" (merged 2026-08-14). Two Cline installations on different builds shut each other's Hub daemon down in loop, sessions died with abnormal socket close (code=1006) as daemon killed mid-handshake. Retire decision was one-sided predicate: each client independently asked "may I reuse this Hub?", two clients on differing builds both answered no. #13177 added build-epoch ordering to break tie, but left every unordered case (missing epoch, missing build id) retiring as before, so any pair involving build from before epochs were embedded still looped. Derive decision from total order instead. compareHubBuilds orders two builds by embedded epoch, then core release version, then build id, is antisymmetric by construction, so at most one side of pair can decide to retire. Hub that is newer or cannot be ordered is attached over compatible wire protocol and left to build-mismatch watcher to prompt about. Genuine protocol incompatibility still replaces. Identity now read from same fields on both sides. Scope development Hub owner by build id so differing dev builds run own daemon side by side instead of contending for one record. Production keeps singleton. Break circuit after repeated retirements of same URL, bounding any future ordering bug to stale-build prompt rather than unusable Hub. Report `cline doctor fix` honestly: separate processes that survived kill from ones that appeared while fix ran, name live parent respawning daemon, mark startup lock held by running process as held rather than leaked.
- **Why**: Alexi has no shared Hub daemon (single-process CLI, no multi-installation coordination). Skip (Cline-specific Hub lifecycle architecture, no cross-cutting pattern for Alexi's single-process model, zero portable insights).
- **Source**: Cline PR #13230 "fix(core): stop concurrent Hub installs from retiring each other" (merged 2026-08-14). Full PR at https://github.com/cline/cline/pull/13230. Root cause: one-sided retire predicate, two clients on differing builds both retired each other in loop. Fix: total order via compareHubBuilds (epoch -> core version -> build id, antisymmetric), attach to newer/unorderable Hub over wire, genuine protocol incompatibility replaces. Scope dev Hub owner by build id, break circuit after repeated retirements, honest `cline doctor fix` reporting.
- **Category**: infra (Hub lifecycle). **Size**: ~4h. **Priority**: SKIP (Cline-specific Hub daemon architecture, no shared daemon in Alexi).

- Kilo #13114 "fix(tui): stop leftover toast titles during update install": SolidJS store merge kept previous toast title when next toast omitted it, so update prompt reused "MCP Authentication Required". TUI toast state bug (SolidJS). Skip.
- Kilo #13111 "docs: document --worktree flag in CLI reference": Regenerate auto-generated CLI reference so kilo --worktree is listed. Documentation update. Skip.
- Kilo #12373 "fix(cli): stop read-only agent bash denies from blocking delegated subagents": When read-only or delegating agent (plan, ask, orchestrator) delegated to custom subagent via task tool, subagent blocked from running commands its own config explicitly allowed (e.g. `git status`) with errors citing deny rules user never wrote (`git *`, `*`, shell-operator guards). Phantom rules are calling agent's `readOnlyBash` allowlist. Its deny rules exist only to shape allowlist; `KiloTask.inherited` extracted them (deny-only) and appended as subagent ceilings, where last-match-wins made `git * deny` / `* deny` override subagent's own allows. Drop `bash` from inherited-ceiling set so calling agent's own bash policy no longer caps writable subagent. Edit, notebook, MCP denials remain hard ceilings. Built-in Explore now has enforcement-level read-only bash policy even if user config sets `bash: allow`. Plan and orchestrator delegation deny mutations while allowing `git status` and `rg`. Custom writable subagents retain own bash allowlists. Kilo-specific multi-agent delegation + permission inheritance (Alexi has no read-only agent delegation model, no built-in Plan/Explore agents, no inherited-ceiling permission logic). Skip.
- Kilo #13108 "fix(cli): surface commit-message generation errors": Map generation failures to typed 422 so SCM toast shows real timeout or provider error instead of generic check-server-logs 500.
